text:
Emily: Quick sync — need final call on SMB pricing carve for the Liftboard launch. Customer ask from Acme Health: priority-lane + 100k embedding units included. Do we want this as an add-on or fold into Starter tier?
Raj: leaning add-on. folding into Starter changes cost curve a lot.
Lucas: agree w/ Raj. Starter already has pricing sensitivity. Add-on keeps upgrade motion clear.
Olivia: the ask also includes contract constraint: 6mo commit or we don't give the included units. Is that workable?
Raj: 6mo commitment aligns with Dedicated sales model. For hosted SMB it feels aggressive. Maybe 3mo with optional renewal.
Emily: Sales ran numbers — Acme will only accept embedded units if it's in the initial quote. They want to pilot for 3 months then expand.
Lucas: proposal: ship as "priority-lane add-on" with two SKUs: Pilot (3mo, 50k units included) and Scale (12mo, 100k units included + 5% discount). Pilot auto-upgrades to Scale after contract if they opt-in.
Olivia: we need launch criteria spelled out. Ops requires: quota enforcement, per-tenant telemetry in console, and circuit-breaker for priority lane when util > 80%.
Emily: agreed. Devex needs SDK flags and docs. Product-bot: created ticket #PROD-8234 for quota enforcement.
Raj: perf note — priority lane must preserve 99th pct latency SLO; if we degrade, fallback to standard lane. Add rollback policy to rollout checklist.
Lucas: can we support 100k embeddings in Pilot technically? Backend: suggest soft-limit with warnings; hard-limit enforced at 110k. Example config: 
```
quota: {
  included_embeddings: 50000,
  hard_limit: 55000,
  spike_window_s: 300
}
```
Emily: that config looks fine. Ops: make sure alerts fire on spike_window breach.
Olivia: launch gating checklist draft:
- Pilot contract signed (sales)
- Quota enforcement ticket merged (eng)
- Priority telemetry dashboard (observability)
- Latency regression < 2% vs baseline (SRE)
- Docs + SDK example (devex)
Raj: timeline? Sales wants pilot in 6 weeks. Engineering estimates 4 weeks for quota + 2 weeks for telemetry + 1 week buffer = 7 weeks. Close.
Emily: decision: approve add-on path with Pilot/Scale SKUs. Action items:
- Raj: finalize SKU pricing and commit terms (due EOD Tue)
- Lucas: implement quota enforcement + hard-limit (PR by next Thurs)
- Olivia: dashboard + alerts (POC in 2 weeks)
- Emily: coordinate contract language with legal + sales
product-bot: scheduled reminder for follow-ups in 3 days. :calendar:
Raj: one more ask — do we want a free trial of the Pilot for customers who opt-in via trial credits? Pricing-wise it's okay if trial limited to 10k units.
Emily: ok tentatively. Add to backlog and call it out in sales guidance.
Olivia: noted. I'll draft the SLA footnote: priority lane best-effort fallback to standard lane on overload; credits for SLO misses limited to 10% of monthly spend.
Emily: thanks team — we'll sync again after Raj's SKU note. :thumbsup:
